scripts.text:
[Warpra]
Hello,
I can warp you to any town or dungeon, but you need to unlock them first by visiting us.
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[沃普拉]
你好，
我可以将你传送到任何城镇或地下城，但你需要先通过访问来解锁它们。
你需要什么服务？

scripts.text:
Basic - Warps are = {0}^000000
Basic - Warps are starter towns and related dungeons.
scripts.translation:
基础 - 传送费用 = {0}^000000
基础 - 传送包括起始城镇及其相关地下城。

scripts.text:
Advanced - Warps are = {0}^000000
Advanced - Warps are towns and dungeons on the same island but not close to any starter town.
scripts.translation:
高级 - 传送费用 = {0}^000000
高级 - 传送包括同一岛屿上但不靠近起始城镇的城镇和地下城。

scripts.text:
Overseas - Warps are = {0}^000000
Overseas - Warps are towns and dungeons overseas reachable by boat from Alberta.
scripts.translation:
海外 - 传送费用 = {0}^000000
海外 - 传送包括从艾尔贝塔乘船可达的海外城镇和地下城。

scripts.text:
Basic Dungeon level warp fee = {0}^000000 zeny per level
Basic - Warps are starter town related dungeons.
Dungeon warp fees are calculated by maps away from entrance of the dungeon times Dungeon warp fee.
These costs are on top of the regular Warp costs.
scripts.translation:
基础地下城层级传送费 = {0}^000000 Zeny/层
基础 - 传送包括起始城镇相关的地下城。
地下城传送费根据距离地下城入口的地图数量乘以地下城传送费计算。
这些费用是在常规传送费之外额外收取的。

scripts.text:
Advanced Dungeon level warp fee = {0}^000000 zeny per level
Advanced - Warps are dungeons not close to any starter town.
Dungeon warp fees are calculated by maps away from entrance of the dungeon times Dungeon warp fee.
These costs are on top of the regular Warp costs.
scripts.translation:
高级地下城层级传送费 = {0}^000000 Zeny/层
高级 - 传送包括不靠近任何起始城镇的地下城。
地下城传送费根据距离地下城入口的地图数量乘以地下城传送费计算。
这些费用是在常规传送费之外额外收取的。

scripts.text:
Overseas Dungeon level warp fee = {0}^000000 zeny per level
Overseas - Warps are dungeons related to towns overseas reachable by boat from Alberta.
Dungeon warp fees are calculated by maps away from entrance of the dungeon times Dungeon warp fee.
These costs are on top of the regular Warp costs.
scripts.translation:
海外地下城层级传送费 = {0}^000000 Zeny/层
海外 - 传送包括从艾尔贝塔乘船可达的海外城镇相关的地下城。
地下城传送费根据距离地下城入口的地图数量乘以地下城传送费计算。
这些费用是在常规传送费之外额外收取的。

scripts.text:
Set the map in the ^0000FFmapname^000000 format.
When this warpmap is set the option for players will show once they meet the requirements.
To disable Special Warp Menu option, clear this!
scripts.translation:
以 ^0000FFmapname^000000 格式设置地图。
设置此传送地图后，当玩家满足条件时，将显示该选项。
若要禁用特殊传送菜单选项，请清空此项！

scripts.text:
Set limit of Dungeon Depth 0 = entrance
Depth 1 is a map connected to 0 and so on
Shortest Route to map counts as depth

深度 1 是连接入口的地图，以此类推
到达地图的最短路径计为深度
